text: This staff report concerns a matter for which the North York Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to advise Community Council concerning an application by the property owner of 56 Otter Crescent for a site-specific Fence Exemption, pursuant to Section 447-1.5(B) of Toronto Municipal Code, Chapter 447- Fences. The property owner is seeking Community Council's permission to keep a fence for a pool enclosure that does not meet the 1.2 metre height due to dense entwined cedar branches, which would not comply with the standards stipulated by Section 447-1.3(D)(1) of the bylaw.

North York Community Council: 1. Granted a fence exemption permit with conditions to the property owners of 56 Otter Crescent, thereby allowing the proposed fence to remain. Directed and required that the installation be maintained in good repair without alteration. At such time as replacement of the fence is required that such installation will comply with Municipal Code Chapter 447 (Fences), or its successor by-law.
